demo.title: Take profit on a confirmed position
demo.code: Use bankr-take-profit to prepare a dry run selling half of a confirmed spot position at 50% above its fill price. Show the exact quantity, target, proceeds token and expiry. Do not submit an order.

setup: Install this skill in your Bankr agent.
Provide the exact chain, token, position quantity or fill reference, profit target, output asset and expiry.
Use an authorized trading session to place orders; dry runs do not require transaction authority.
